These builds are not code-signed yet, so each system warns the first time.

- **macOS:** unzip, then run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine eincast.app` (or right-click, Open, the first time).
- **Windows:** SmartScreen will warn; choose **More info, Run anyway**.

Not every device has been tried: the list of what has is in [docs/TESTING-DEVICES.md](https://github.com/bkjonathan/ein-cast/blob/main/docs/TESTING-DEVICES.md).
